elements.text: Worldwide Customers for AI-Powered Performance and Load Testing Services Executive Summary This document presents a comprehensive list of potential customers for AI-powered performance and load testing services, with a focus on mid-sized companies in advanced economies (United States, Europe, Australia) as requested.
The list is organized by industry, with fintech prioritized as specified.

Each entry includes: - Company information (name, website, headquarters, size) - Key technical decision-maker contact details - Specific performance testing needs - Notes on why the company would benefit from these services Fintech Companies Stripe Company: Stripe Website: stripe.com Company Size: Mid-sized (2,000+ employees) Key Contact: David Singleton Email: d*@stripe.com (email format likely david@stripe.com or dsingleton@stripe.com) LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/davidpsingleton Performance Testing Needs: Payment processing infrastructure, API reliability, transaction processing systems Notes: Previously at Google, leads engineering and design teams at Stripe.
Stripe processes billions of dollars in payments and would benefit from robust performance testing for their payment infrastructure.
Klarna Company: Klarna

Website: klarna.com Headquarters: Stockholm, Sweden (with operations in US, Europe, Australia) Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 5,000 employees) Key Contact: Yaron Shaer Email: y**@klarna.com (email format likely yaron@klarna.com or yshaer@klarna.com) LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/yaron-shaer-1938103 Performance Testing Needs: Payment processing, checkout experience, mobile app performance Notes: Based in Berlin, Germany.
Klarna is a leading buy-now-pay-later platform that processes millions of transactions daily and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing.

Wise (formerly TransferWise) Company: Wise Website: wise.com Headquarters: London, United Kingdom (with offices in Austin, TX) Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 3,000 employees) Key Contact: Harsh Sinha Email: Format likely harsh@wise.com or harsh.sinha@wise.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/hasinha Twitter/X: @harshsinha Performance Testing Needs: International money transfer systems, currency exchange platform, mobile app performance Notes: Previously worked at PayPal and eBay.
Wise processes international money transfers for millions of customers and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their cross-border payment infrastructure.

Revolut Company: Revolut Website: revolut.com Headquarters: London, United Kingdom Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 5,000 employees) Key Contact: Vladyslav Yatsenko Title: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Email: vladyslav@revolut.com (alternative: vlad.yatsenko@gmail.com) LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/yatsenko Performance Testing Needs: Banking app performance, payment processing, cryptocurrency exchange functionality Notes: Co-founded Revolut with Nik Storonsky.
Revolut offers digital banking services to millions of customers worldwide and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their mobile app and transaction processing systems.

Adyen Company: Adyen Website: adyen.com Headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 2,500 employees) Key Contact: Tom Adams Email: t**@adyen.com (format likely tom.adams@adyen.com) LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tomjadams Performance Testing Needs: Payment processing platform, global payment infrastructure Notes: Recently appointed as CTO in 2024, previously led engineering at Cash App.
Adyen processes payments for major global merchants and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their payment processing infrastructure.

Affirm Company: Affirm Website: affirm.com Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 2,000 employees) Key Contact: Libor Michalek Title: President of Technology (CTO equivalent) Email: Format likely libor@affirm.com or libor.michalek@affirm.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/liborm Performance Testing Needs: Buy-now-pay-later platform, checkout integration, loan processing systems
Notes: Oversees engineering, risk, operations, product and design at Affirm.
The company processes millions of buy-now-pay-later transactions and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their checkout integration and loan processing systems.

N26 Company: N26 Website: n26.com Headquarters: Berlin, Germany Key Contact: Gino Cordt Email: Format likely gino@n26.com or gino.cordt@n26.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/gino-cordt-48377027 Performance Testing Needs: Digital banking platform, mobile app performance, transaction processing Notes: Oversees the firm's Data and Technology divisions.
N26 is a leading European digital bank with millions of users and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their mobile banking platform.

Chime Company: Chime Website: chime.com Key Contact: Jeff Currier Email: Format likely jeff@chime.com or jeff.currier@chime.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jeff-currier Performance Testing Needs: Mobile banking app, transaction processing, account management systems Notes: Recently joined Chime as CTO in 2024.
Chime is a leading digital banking platform with millions of users and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their mobile app and transaction processing systems.

SoFi Company: SoFi Website: sofi.com Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 4,000 employees) Key Contact: Jeremy Rishel Email: Format likely jeremy@sofi.com or jeremy.rishel@sofi.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jeremyrishel Performance Testing Needs: Lending platform, investment services, banking app performance Notes: Joined SoFi in 2022.
SoFi offers a comprehensive suite of financial services including lending, investing, and banking to millions of users and would benefit from robust performance testing of their digital platforms.

Plaid Company: Plaid Website: plaid.com Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 1,200 employees) Key Contact: Jean-Denis Greze Email: g**@plaid.com (format likely greze@plaid.com or jd@plaid.com) LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jeandenisgreze Twitter/X: @jgreze Performance Testing Needs: Financial data connectivity, API performance, banking integration systems Notes: Plaid connects thousands of apps with financial institutions and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing of their API infrastructure and banking integration systems.
E-commerce Companies Shopify Company: Shopify Website: shopify.com

Headquarters: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada Company Size: Mid-sized to Large (approximately 10,000 employees) Target Contact Role: VP of Engineering or Director of Infrastructure Performance Testing Needs: E-commerce platform, checkout process, merchant dashboard Notes: Shopify powers millions of online stores and would benefit from comprehensive performance testing during high-traffic shopping events.

BigCommerce Company: BigCommerce Website: bigcommerce.com Headquarters: Austin, Texas, United States Performance Testing Needs: E-commerce platform, checkout process, merchant tools Notes: BigCommerce serves thousands of online merchants and would benefit from load testing during peak shopping seasons.

Etsy Company: Etsy Website: etsy.com Headquarters: Brooklyn, New York, United States Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 2,500 employees) Performance Testing Needs: Marketplace platform, search functionality, payment processing Notes: Etsy hosts millions of sellers and buyers and would benefit from performance testing of their marketplace infrastructure.

Wayfair Company: Wayfair Website: wayfair.com Headquarters: Boston, Massachusetts, United States Company Size: Mid-sized to Large (approximately 15,000 employees) Performance Testing Needs: E-commerce platform, search functionality, checkout process
Notes: Wayfair handles millions of home goods products and would benefit from performance testing of their platform during sales events.

ASOS Company: ASOS Website: asos.com Headquarters: London, United Kingdom Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 3,000 employees) Target Contact Role: CTO or Head of Technology Performance Testing Needs: E-commerce platform, mobile app performance, checkout process Notes: ASOS is a major online fashion retailer that would benefit from performance testing during peak shopping seasons.

Healthcare Companies Teladoc Health Company: Teladoc Health Website: teladoc.com Headquarters: Purchase, New York, United States Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 5,000 employees) Performance Testing Needs: Telehealth platform, video streaming, patient portal Notes: Teladoc handles thousands of virtual healthcare visits daily and would benefit from performance testing of their telehealth infrastructure.

Amwell Company: Amwell Website: amwell.com Headquarters: Boston, Massachusetts, United States Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 2,000 employees) Performance Testing Needs: Telehealth platform, video consultation, patient data management Notes: Amwell provides telehealth services to healthcare providers and would benefit from performance testing of their platform.

Innovaccer Company: Innovaccer Website: innovaccer.com Performance Testing Needs: Healthcare data platform, analytics dashboards, data processing Notes: Innovaccer processes massive healthcare datasets and would benefit from performance testing of their data processing systems.

Quartet Health Company: Quartet Health Website: quartethealth.com Headquarters: New York, New York, United States Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 500 employees) Performance Testing Needs: Mental health platform, provider matching, patient portal Notes: Quartet Health connects patients with mental health providers and would benefit from performance testing of their matching algorithms.

NuvoAir Company: NuvoAir Website: nuvoair.com Headquarters: Boston, Massachusetts, United States (with European operations) Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 200 employees) Target Contact Role: CTO or Head of Engineering Performance Testing Needs: Remote monitoring platform, device connectivity, data synchronization Notes: NuvoAir provides respiratory care monitoring and would benefit from performance testing of their device connectivity and data synchronization systems.
Gaming Companies Epic Games Company: Epic Games

Website: epicgames.com Headquarters: Cary, North Carolina, United States Company Size: Mid-sized to Large (approximately 3,200 employees) Performance Testing Needs: Game engine, online multiplayer infrastructure, digital storefront Notes: Epic Games operates Fortnite and the Epic Games Store, which would benefit from performance testing during game launches and events.

Riot Games Company: Riot Games Website: riotgames.com Headquarters: Los Angeles, California, United States Company Size: Mid-sized to Large (approximately 3,000 employees) Target Contact Role: CTO or Director of Engineering Performance Testing Needs: Online multiplayer infrastructure, matchmaking systems, tournament platforms Notes: Riot Games operates competitive esports titles that would benefit from performance testing during tournaments and game updates.

Supercell Company: Supercell Website: supercell.com Headquarters: Helsinki, Finland Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 500 employees) Target Contact Role: CTO or Head of Technology Performance Testing Needs: Mobile game infrastructure, real-time multiplayer, in- app purchases Notes: Supercell creates popular mobile games with millions of players and would benefit from performance testing during game launches and updates. miHoYo Company: miHoYo Website: mihoyo.com Headquarters: Shanghai, China (with global operations) Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 4,000 employees) Target Contact Role: CTO or Technical Director

Performance Testing Needs: Cross-platform game infrastructure, open-world game performance, server infrastructure Notes: miHoYo develops Genshin Impact and would benefit from performance testing of their cross-platform infrastructure during major updates.

Pingle Studio Company: Pingle Studio Website: pinglestudio.com Headquarters: Kyiv, Ukraine (with operations in US and Europe) Company Size: Mid-sized (approximately 300 employees) Target Contact Role: CTO or Head of QA Performance Testing Needs: Game development infrastructure, testing systems, client project management Notes: Pingle Studio provides game development and testing services and would benefit from advanced performance testing capabilities for their clients.

Regional Distribution North America United States: Stripe, Affirm, Chime, SoFi, Plaid, Shopify, BigCommerce, Etsy, Wayfair, Teladoc Health, Amwell, Innovaccer, Quartet Health, NuvoAir, Epic Games, Riot Games Canada: Shopify Europe United Kingdom: Wise, Revolut, ASOS Netherlands: Adyen Germany: N26 Sweden: Klarna Finland: Supercell Ukraine: Pingle Studio Asia-Pacific Australia: (Operations of global companies like Wise, Klarna) China: miHoYo

needs that align well with the services offered.
